slides.heading: Employment Landscape
lines: Large youth bulge with most of KP under 30
Hundreds of thousands of new job seekers every year
Unemployment highest among educated youth & women
Informal sector absorbs most of the workforce
Remittances a key income source for many households
Merged districts lag on every jobs indicator

slides.heading: Key Challenges
lines: Skills mismatch between training & market demand
Weak industrial base | Low private investment
Limited access to finance for small firms
Poor energy supply & connectivity in remote districts
Low female labour force participation
No real-time labour market information
Security perception deters investors

slides.heading: TVET Today
lines: Many institutes with low enrolment & weak outcomes
Outdated curricula | Obsolete equipment
Training led by supply, not employer demand
Few links with industry for placements
Weak certification & quality assurance
Little tracking of graduate employment

slides.heading: TVET Reform
lines: Demand-driven courses designed with employers
Competency-based training & assessment in all trades
Industry boards to govern every major institute
Apprenticeships & on-the-job training made mandatory
Instructor upskilling | Modern labs
Funding linked to graduate placement results
Digital & freelancing skills in every district

slides.heading: Growth Centres
lines: Special Economic Zones as anchors for job creation
Rashakai | Hattar | Nowshera industrial clusters
District growth centres built on local strengths
Tourism hubs in Swat | Chitral | Galiyat
Marble & mineral processing in Buner & Mohmand
Agro-processing clusters for fruit & dairy
Plug-and-play facilities for small enterprises

slides.heading: Private Sector Links
lines: Employer councils to shape skills priorities
Public-private partnerships to run TVET institutes
Wage subsidies for first-time hires
Paid internships for graduates in local firms
Single window for investor approvals
Chambers of commerce as active partners
Overseas employment linked to certified skills

slides.heading: Key Enablers
lines: Easy credit for youth & women entrepreneurs
Labour market information system for KP
Reliable power | Better road links
Online business registration & licensing
Targeted support for merged districts
Skills training for women close to home

slides.heading: Way Forward
lines: Set up a KP Jobs Task Force under CM
Pilot reformed TVET in 5 districts by Jun, 27
Launch employer councils in each growth centre
Fast-track approvals in Special Economic Zones
Track jobs created on a public dashboard
Scale what works | Close what does not
Review progress every quarter
